metalcraft.options.title: MetalCraft Settings
metalcraft.options.half_resolution.descr: Render at macOS logical resolution instead of the Retina display's 2x backing resolution. The image is upscaled to the native Metal surface for a substantial GPU performance gain.
metalcraft.options.half_resolution.toolt: Halves each framebuffer dimension, reducing the rendered pixel count to one quarter.
metalcraft.options.unlocked_frame_rate.t: Presents without display synchronization and ignores Minecraft's Max Framerate and one-minute AFK limits, so frames are not paced to the display's refresh rate. Iconified, ten-minute idle, and menu throttles still apply.
metalcraft.water.water_enabled.tooltip: Animated water, reflections, absorption, foam, and underwater distortion. Off restores the original water appearance.
metalcraft.water.water_wave_strength.too: Surface ripple strength. Zero keeps the water surface normal still.
metalcraft.water.water_refraction_streng: Background distortion through water. Zero removes distortion while preserving depth absorption.
metalcraft.water.water_absorption.toolti: How strongly depth colors and dims the view through water. Zero keeps background transmission clear.
metalcraft.water.water_foam.tooltip: Restrained foam at shallow contacts. Zero disables foam.
metalcraft.water.water_underwater_distor: Mild distortion of the world while submerged. Zero disables distortion; underwater fog remains.
metalcraft.water.water_reflection_qualit: Baseline reflects the sky and sun. Screen-space tiers also reflect visible opaque objects, at extra cost. Off-screen and transparent objects use the baseline fallback.
metalcraft.water.water_detail.tooltip: Fine surface ripples. None retains broad waves; higher levels add smaller ripples. Distant detail fades to prevent shimmer.
